emulator: MAME 0.289, gameboy with no link device; tools/oracle/barcode_boy.lua answers the serial port the way a Barcode Boy does
screen: each code is scanned at the team editing barcode prompt from one saved state; kind is the game's flag at $C30E, record the 16-byte player copied to $C310, pointer the address in bank $0A it was copied from, stored at $C330
